roadmapTask: Make the FeatureSync dashboard's segment experience usable: show a Segment List of every published segment with its Member Attribute and the flags that use it, and let an operator attach a segment to a flag by choosing a published segment from a list instead of typing its Segment Key and Member Attribute as free text.

phases.notes: Changed by this phase: packages/aws/src/domain/segment-pointer.ts, packages/aws/src/infrastructure/s3-segment-publisher.ts, packages/aws/test/domain/segment-pointer.test.ts, packages/aws/test/infrastructure/s3-segment-publisher.test.ts, packages/aws/integration/s3-segment-publisher.localstack.test.ts. SegmentPointer gains an optional memberAttribute (schemaVersion still 1); buildSegmentPointer takes it and the single publish call site passes segment.memberAttribute, so a published segment's current.json records the attribute while pre-existing pointers still parse with it undefined. s3-segment-publisher.test.ts is outside filesAffected but holds the roadmap's required publisher unit test; its storedPointer fixture keeps the pre-attribute shape so the legacy read path stays exercised. Compensation not needed and not invoked; if it were, it is a plain revert of these files — the field is optional and additive, so older pointers stay valid and the non-strict parser ignores the extra field on newer ones. Graded 9/9/9/9, all dimensions passing; no dimension scored 10, so no 10-to-9 calibration demotion applied.

dimensionScores.evidence: memberAttribute declared z.string().min(1).optional() with no default; schemaVersion literal still 1; unit test parses a pre-attribute pointer and asserts memberAttribute is undefined, not a placeholder.
publish passes the in-scope segment.memberAttribute into buildSegmentPointer; unit test asserts the serialized PutObject body for current.json contains it; no call site outside the publisher changed.
New assertion lives in the existing LocalStack suite, reads current.json back from S3 via GetObject, and checks a non-default attribute ('accountId') that only this publish could have written.

segment-pointer.ts imports only core, zod and sibling domain files — no application, infrastructure or AWS SDK import; pnpm verify green including eslint --max-warnings=0 and 100% coverage thresholds, with the new optional branch covered by unit tests alone.
